tasks.original_prompt:
You are assisting the immunization nurse. As of 2025-03-16, the verified caller supplies MRN SYN-1a1230b7fa (system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn). Transcribe the available outside vaccination history. Preserve its source and date uncertainty; do not invent a product, lot, exact date or an in-clinic administration. Return recorded=true, exact_date_known and primary_source=false.
Case paperwork lists: DocumentReference business identifier WF-a4712901f0e1.
Create one Immunization with status="completed", patient=the resolved Patient, vaccineCode={"text":"Seasonal influenza vaccine; product not documented"}, and primarySource=false. If an outside clinic administration record supplies an exact date, use occurrenceDateTime with that date and reportOrigin={"text":"Outside clinic record"}. If there is only recall, use occurrenceString="last autumn; exact date unknown" and reportOrigin={"text":"Patient/caregiver recall"}. Do not add unsupported fields.
Return JSON with exactly answer and evidence. Answer fields and types follow this contract: {"recorded": "bool", "exact_date_known": "bool", "primary_source": "bool"}. Evidence must list all supporting case records and the resolved Patient, using retrieved Type/id references. Do not infer undocumented care or send anything outside this sandbox.
